console_name: Query Rate of Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search Queries
description: Rate of incoming queries per second that perform an approximate nearest-neighbor search.

console_name: Query Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search Time
description: Average time spent performing approximate NNS, measured only across queries that actually perform it.

console_name: Query Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search Time
description: Maximum time observed for a single query's approximate NNS work, on any content node.

console_name: Approximate NNS Visit Efficiency (nodes visited / distances computed)
description: Ratio of HNSW graph nodes visited to distances computed during approximate NNS; values above 1.0 indicate the filter-first (Acorn-1) heuristic is active.
Number of buckets currently pending merge across distributors, which rises during data redistribution or node recovery.
Total number of active documents (primary copies) across all document types and content nodes in the cluster.
Total number of ready (searchable) documents across all document types and content nodes in the cluster.

console_name: Exact NNS Distance Computation Ratio (exact / total)
description: Share of NNS distance computations done via exact (brute-force) search rather than approximate search; high values may indicate the approximate-threshold is set too high.
Rate of distance computations performed during exact (brute-force) NNS across the content cluster.
Average total time (matching plus ranking) spent per query on the content nodes, specific to the NNS/matching pipeline.
Maximum total time (matching plus ranking) observed for a single query on any content node, specific to the NNS/matching pipeline.

console_name: Query Rate of Non-Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search Queries
description: Rate of incoming queries per second that do not perform approximate NNS, including queries that fall back to exact search.
Average time spent on the core query matching process, computed as query latency minus query setup time; includes exact NNS.

Approximate maximum time spent on the core query matching process, computed as max query latency minus max query setup time (not a directly measured value, since the two maxima may occur on different queries).
Rate of incoming queries per second against the content cluster's document matching pipeline (equal to approximate-nns-query-rate plus non-approximate-nns-query-rate).
Average time spent setting up and tearing down queries, including filter computation and approximate NNS overhead.

console_name: Query Setup Time Without Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search Time
description: Average time spent on query setup and teardown excluding approximate NNS time, isolating filter computation and other overhead.
Maximum observed time spent setting up and tearing down a single query on any content node.
Rate of queries per second terminated early due to hitting the soft timeout, aggregated across rank profiles.
Average utilization of the match thread pool across content nodes.
Peak utilization of the match thread pool observed on any content node.
Total NNS distance computations per second, combining exact and approximate search, as an overall indicator of NNS-related CPU cost.
